doctrine: A cell is covered only when a test that actually ran selected it. Nothing
here declares coverage; scripts/proven/verify-ledger.py derives it from a
test inventory produced by `cargo test -- --list` in the same commit.
Tiers are the framework's three: Actually-Proven (a machine-checked proof
evidence, no proof object), Unproven (no type-safety warranty). This repo
has no proof-carrying Rust tests, so almost everything is
Provisionally-Proven and says so rather than borrowing a stronger word.
Absent cells are declared absent, with the command that would test them.
A declared absence is a to-do list, not a silencer.

entries.evidence: Per-language detection, WeakPoint construction and pattern tables.
Injection, deserialisation and crypto-misuse patterns (PA003, PA005, PA022).
Regression fixtures plus the CRG readiness grades D/C/B.
proptest invariants over report construction and canonical JSON.
Invariants that must hold for every generated input, not one fixture.
Seam contracts: the JSON/SARIF/PanLL surfaces other tools consume.
Schema versions, event-chain shape and CLI contract stability.
PanLL event export and report rendering, including SARIF runs.
I-JSON/JCS artefacts: equal data yields equal bytes, one trailing LF.
Named defects stay fixed; corpus scans stay bounded.
Scan -> detect -> report, exercised through the built binary.
Process-level smoke: the CLI starts and produces parseable output.
Multi-language inputs and the PHP adapter across templates, traits and namespaces.
unsafe-deserialisation checks: unserialize with and without object options.
Folds a real Idris2 proof artifact and asserts the Closed verdict; the test is example-based even though the artifact is proof-carrying.
proven-tests run-report ingestion: hashing, tier mapping and defect detection (library unit tests).
Hexad write/load and campaign lifecycle state transitions.
Ambient stressors, mutation combinations and isolation/time-skew, at unit level.
miniKanren unification, taint and cross-language reasoning.
Ten-language message catalogue and A2ML manifest lookup.
The built artefact exists and runs: readiness grades D/C/B exercise the release binary end to end, so a build that does not build cannot pass.
Aspect/report structure tests that keep the public shape reviewable.
